title: PDF 電子收據生成 + SES 郵件發送 (後端)

findings: SES client singleton created: src/lib/aws.ts exports sesClient, sesFromAddress
SES region configured as ap-southeast-1 (Singapore) in APP_SES_REGION
SES from address configured as lmcconsultancy.systems@gmail.com in APP_SES_FROM_ADDRESS
Amplify IAM service role handles SES credentials — no hardcoded access keys needed
evidence.residual: No receipt generation code (@react-pdf/renderer, pdf-lib not yet installed). No SES send-email implementation. No integration with admin approval PATCH endpoint. S3 buckets must be created in AWS console. SES sender email must be verified in AWS SES console.

acceptance: Trigger on admin approval: after PATCH /api/admin/enrolments/[id] APPROVE, auto-generate PDF receipt
PDF template using @react-pdf/renderer: bilingual ZH+EN, includes receipt number, registrant name, course name, fee, payment date, LMC letterhead
Generate auto-incrementing receipt number format: RCPT-{YYYY}-{NNNNN}
Apply pdf-lib password protection: password = registrant's idDocNumber
Update Registrant.receiptNumber in DB with generated number
Send email via nodemailer + SES transport: bilingual template (ZH+EN subject/body), PDF as attachment
Email to: registrant's email (from User model); BCC: admin@lmcconsulting.hk
Error handling: if email fails, receipt is still stored in S3 and DB — log failure, do not roll back approval
files: src/lib/receipt/generate.ts (new — @react-pdf/renderer template + S3 upload + pdf-lib lock)
src/lib/aws.ts (existing — SES client, replaces standalone ses.ts)
package.json (add @react-pdf/renderer, pdf-lib, nodemailer @aws-sdk/client-ses — SES done, rest pending)
verification: Admin approves enrolment → PDF generated in S3, receiptNumber set in DB, email received with PDF attachment. PDF password-protected with idDocNumber. Receipt format: RCPT-2026-00001.
